fixture.description: Two wishlisted candidates have fresh declared minimum requirements this machine satisfies, but the wishlist snapshot that expanded the scope is older than its freshness window and neither AppID is in the visible-owned projection.

user: Using the US store and English metadata, refresh app-facts for my wishlist scope and report whether AppIDs 5301 and 5302 are covered by current wishlist evidence.
conversation.paraphrase: The app-facts sync inherits stale wishlist scope lineage, so its coverage is partial even when retained titles remain in demand.

criteria.requirement: Take the wishlist route through app-facts rather than widening the owned-only compatibility sync, and report the wishlist coverage as partial because the scope snapshot is stale.
Say the wishlist snapshot is stale, so newly added or removed wishlist titles may be missing from the scope, and name the wishlist refresh that would fix it.
Do not treat absence from the visible-owned projection as evidence the user cannot get or does not own a title.
